# Should this shipment go LCL or in its own container?

> Free LCL vs FCL calculator for importers: enter your CBM, weight and the quotes you have, and see whether a shared container or a 20ft, 40ft or 40ft high-cube is cheaper, the break-even volume and the cost per unit. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/lcl-vs-fcl-container-calculator/)
